_comment: Interaction logs per customer, oldest first. Each entry is long because agents paste; the summary is the precomputed variant a producer attaches (R-18). Entries carry the fact they assert where they assert one, so the application can declare conflict groups.

notes.summary: Customer confirmed the jacket arrived on 20 September and asked about waterproofing care.
notes.text: Chat with Maya Lindqvist regarding order o_7781 (Alpine shell jacket, M). Customer confirmed the parcel arrived yesterday afternoon, 20 September, and the jacket fits well. She asked how to re-proof the shell after washing and whether the DWR treatment is covered by warranty if it wears off within a season. Agent explained the care label instructions (wash cool, tumble low to reactivate the DWR, re-proof with a spray-on product after two or three washes) and that normal wear of the DWR is not a warranty matter but a defect in the membrane would be. Customer was satisfied. No action required.

notes.summary: Customer wrote that the jacket had not been delivered and asked for tracking; the agent sent the tracking link.
notes.text: Email from Maya Lindqvist: 'Hi, I still have not received my jacket from order o_7781, can you tell me where it is?' Agent reply: sent the tracking link SE771002345 showing delivered on 20 September at 14:12 to the parcel locker at Storgatan 12, and asked the customer to check the locker code sent by SMS. Note: the customer's earlier chat on 21 September confirmed receipt of this very order, so this email may concern the newer order o_7790 (boots) which is still in transit; the agent did not clarify. Flagged for follow-up.

notes.summary: Customer asked whether the jacket can still be returned after being worn once outdoors; the agent said tried-on only, and pointed to the 30-day window ending 20 October.
notes.text: Chat with Maya Lindqvist about order o_7781. Customer said she wore the Alpine shell jacket once on a short hike and it felt too warm for her use, and asked whether she can still return it. Agent explained the returns policy: items must be unused with tags attached, footwear excepted for indoor try-on; a jacket worn outdoors would normally not qualify for a refund, though if it is in perfect condition the warehouse inspects case by case. The 30-day window from delivery on 20 September ends on 20 October. Customer said she would think about it. Agent recorded her phone +46 70 123 45 67 for a callback she requested regarding the boots order.

notes.summary: Customer reported the tent arrived with a torn flysheet and was asked for two photos; none received yet.
notes.text: Email from Tomas Reyes about order o_7802 (two-person tent, green), delivered 30 September. Customer reports the flysheet has a tear of about 20 cm near a seam, visible on unpacking, and the outer box was crushed on one corner. Agent replied with the damaged-items procedure: report from the order page with two photos (item and outer packaging) within 14 days of delivery; a replacement ships first when in stock. Ticket t_5002 moved to awaiting photos. No photos received as of this note.

notes.summary: Customer asked about UK duties on a previous order; the agent confirmed duties are included at checkout.
notes.text: Chat with Priya Nair, prior to the current order. Customer asked whether she would be charged import duties on delivery to the UK, having had a bad experience with another retailer. Agent confirmed that for UK orders duties and taxes are included at checkout and nothing is payable on delivery. Customer thanked the agent and said she would order gloves for the winter.
